text:
Sam: Quick pulse — can we consolidate the final GA checklist into a single matrix? Need clear go/no-go for SLA, docs, support, monitoring, pricing.
Irene: yes. I'll start a row-per-signal matrix. can we agree SLOs? e.g., p95 latency < 180ms for hosted, error budget 0.5% monthly.
Keith: p95 180ms seems tight for embeddings; suggest p95 < 300ms for embeddings but 180ms for streaming text-gen.
Jordan: +1 to splitting by route. Also need capacity commit for Dedicated: baseline QPS, burst policy, autoscale cooldown.
Priya: docs status: onboarding guide + SDK examples + config snippets. ETA EOD Wed for draft. need someone to own final review.
Sam: @Priya thanks. Can you add a short "rollback decision tree" snippet? we should include triggers and steps.
Irene: adding monitoring row: alerts — error-rate > 0.3% sustained 5m, tail-latency spike, KV cache miss ratio > 20%.
Keith: ops play: canary at 5% traffic for 24h -> 25% for 48h -> full. include automated rollback if error-rate doubling.
Jordan: pricing: recommend two-tier launch: dev (low qps, higher per-token) + production (committed rate, volume discount). need sales input.
Priya: docs snippet:
```
# Canary policy
- canary: 5% traffic for 24h
- metrics: p95, error-rate, latency tail
- rollback: auto if error-rate > 2x baseline or p95 > 2x target
```
Sam: security/compliance: private deployment checklist — KMS, audit logs, network egress rules. @ops-bot can you attach the current template?
ops-bot: Attached template: /assets/templates/private-deploy-checklist-v2.pdf :white_check_mark:
Irene: final ask: owner for each row. I'll make a columns: owner, target, signal, mitigation. assign owners by EOD.
Sam: OK. owners: Irene monitoring, Keith ops, Priya docs, Jordan pricing, Sam product. I'll write the one-pager for execs.
Priya: will schedule 30m sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to lock the matrix. :calendar:
Keith: merging small note — for Dedicated SLA, we need an uptime objective + credits calculation. I'll draft.
Jordan: commercial note: tie burst policy into pricing docs so customers understand limits and extra charges.
Sam: great. If no blockers, we'll use this matrix as the GA criteria artifact and get signoff Thurs.
